cards.claim: The trial of Bessie Broun was a witchcraft trial.
cards.quote: Today, they would bear witness to the trial of Bessie Broun, a local healer accused of consorting with the devil. Bessie, a wispy-haired woman with eyes that seemed to hold a deep wisdom, stood tall in the center of the square, her hands bound by rough rope. The villagers parted as the prosecutor, a stern-faced man named Thomas, approached her. He held a parchment in his hand, adorned with the wax seal of the local lord. "Bessie Broun, thou art accused of witchcraft and sorcery," Thomas declared, his voice echoing off the surrounding buildings.

raw_card.claim: The trial of Bessie Broun was involved in the Commission of Justiciary.
